canonicalization.receipt_hash_definition: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of the receipt object with the receipt_hash field itself excluded. All other fields in the receipt are covered by the hash.
never_in_receipt: machine username (unless the user explicitly requests it)
canonicalization.note: Python and Rust implementations must produce byte-identical canonical JSON (key order, number serialisation) per RFC 8785, or receipt_hash parity will fail.

trust_priority_note: Order from PROJECT_BOOK.md §13.4. NOT_OBSERVED has no position in this order (see SPEC-03 in profile_contract.json). The priority resolves which single trust value a source gets when several conditions apply; it is a classification rule, not a judgement that file content is malicious.
exit_code_note: From PROJECT_BOOK.md §8.8. Default CI mode: WARN is configurable, BLOCK / INPUT_ERROR / INTERNAL_ERROR must be non-zero; INTERNAL_ERROR is fail-closed.

version.description: Must match the id: codex -> codex-2026-11, claude-code -> claude-code-2026-11, copilot-cli -> copilot-cli-2026-11.

rules_hash.description: Optional. The profile rules_hash from profile_contract.json, copied verbatim when present.

cwd.description: Canonical absolute path of the working directory the harness would start in.

repo_root.description: Canonical absolute path of the git repository top level, or null when the CWD is not inside a git repository.

home.description: Optional. Canonical absolute path of the user home directory used for user-scope resolution.

sources.description: Effective instruction chain, in harness discovery order. Empty array is valid (no sources discovered).

edges.description: Import/reference edges between sources (and to missing targets).

policy.description: Optional. The policy the verdict was computed under.

values.description: Policy field values as defined in policy_schema.json (default_policy shape).

receipt_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical receipt JSON with this field excluded.

source_id.description: Stable id in discovery order: src-0001, src-0002, ...

raw_path.description: Path as discovered (may contain ~ or be relative to the CWD).

canonical_path.description: Canonical absolute path, UTF-8, separators normalised; home redacted as <HOME>/... for display only - the hash always uses the unredacted canonical path.

resolved_path.description: Canonical path after symlink/junction resolution. Equals canonical_path when the file is not a symlink.

discovery_rule.description: Rule id from profile_contract.json, e.g. codex.repo-chain.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of file bytes; null only when the file is missing (trust MISSING).

symlink_target.description: Optional. Resolved target when the source is reached through a symlink/junction; null otherwise.

is_symlink.description: Optional. True when any path component is a symlink/junction.

repo.description: Canonical absolute path of the containing git repository top level, or null when not in a git repository.

modified.description: True when the working-tree file differs from HEAD (git status). False for untracked files.

head_commit.description: Full HEAD commit SHA for the file (git log -1), or null when untracked / not in a repo.

kind.description: ORDERED: the profile defines an order (see detail). BEFORE/AFTER: relative order against relative_to (the IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN §4.2 spelling). COMBINE_UNORDERED: the profile combines sources without a general precedence order. UNSPECIFIED: the official source defines no precedence - never guessed.

relative_to.description: Optional. source_ids this source is ordered before/after.

detail.description: Optional. Human-readable statement of the ordering rule and its source.

syntax.description: Raw reference text as written, e.g. @../shared/rules.md.

to.description: source_id of the target when it is itself a receipt source; null when the target is not a source (e.g. missing, or outside the discovered set).

resolved_target.description: Optional. Canonical absolute path the reference resolves to, or null when it cannot be resolved (missing).

allowed.description: False when the edge escapes a trust boundary (import escape) or the target is missing.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason, e.g. WITHIN_REPO, IMPORT_ESCAPE, MISSING, NOT_OBSERVED (approval state unknown).
